subtitle: Lesson 97 · Database Design Fundamentals

caption: A table can have many UNIQUE constraints — but only one primary key.

eyebrow: Added after the fact — the AK_ convention
code:
ALTER TABLE dbo.Department
ADD CONSTRAINT AK_Department_Code UNIQUE (Code);
caption: AdventureWorks2012's real convention: HumanResources.Employee has AK_Employee_NationalIDNumber and AK_Employee_LoginID.
A primary key never allows NULL. UNIQUE allows exactly ONE — SQL Server's unique index treats a 2nd NULL as a duplicate.

code:
-- Primary key: "what row is this?"
DepartmentID INT PRIMARY KEY

-- UNIQUE: "what else has to be one-of-a-kind?"
Name NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE
caption: Two different questions, both enforced by the database, not application code.
